baseline.name: Collect allowed duplicates in a temporary array
baseline.approach: Scan sorted input, keep at most two copies per value in another array, then copy back.

why: Comparing with the retained value two slots behind the write cursor enforces the duplicate limit without another array.
quantitative_comparison: For n>2 the archive inspects n-2 scanned positions and avoids an n-element temporary buffer and copy-back pass. Both methods remain linear; no elapsed-time ratio is available.
tradeoffs: Sorted input and permission to overwrite its prefix are required. The archive is not asymptotically better than other in-place linear solutions.
evidence_basis: Static loop/storage comparison with a temporary-array baseline; no measured benchmark.
